title: ALMA Reveals Spatially Resolved Properties of Molecular Gas in the Host Galaxy of FRB 20191001A at z = 0.2340
question: What are the spatially resolved molecular gas properties and kinematics of the FRB 20191001A host galaxy and its companion, and the gas and continuum limits at the FRB site?

data.sensitivity: 0.92 mJy/beam per 50 km/s channel; 3.0e-2 mJy/beam continuum

what.value: Western source SFR from 1.4 GHz luminosity

evidence.quote: The SFR of the western source is estimated to be about $\SI{21}{M_\odot.yr^{-1}}$ based on the 1.4 GHz luminosity (cite: Bhandari2020).

what.value: Comparison FRB host gas masses and SFRs

evidence.quote: previously observed FRB host galaxies (brown-filled squares from (cite: Hatsukade2022) and (cite: Chittidi2023))

evidence.loc: 4.2 Molecular gas property at the FRB site
evidence.quote: compares it with the cumulative distribution of the SNe (cite: Galbany2017)

recipe.method: tclean with Briggs weighting, cube -1000 to 1000 km/s at 50 km/s; continuum from line-free channels

recipe.goal: Extract spectra, fit line width, flux
recipe.method: Gaussian fit to CO line profile for FWHM; integrated intensity map by summing channels

recipe.goal: Derive CO luminosity and molecular gas mass
recipe.method: L'CO via Solomon & Vanden Bout; Mgas = alphaCO L'CO(1-0)

recipe.goal: Disk kinematic modelling and dynamical mass
recipe.method: 3DBarolo tilted-ring fit, two passes (second with inclination and PA fixed), VRAD=0; Mdyn = R Vrot^2/G
3 sigma upper limit on N(H2) with Galactic conversion factor and 100 km/s linewidth; 3 sigma 1.3 mm continuum limit

evidence.quote: The inferred molecular gas mass of the host galaxy is $\SI{2.3+-0.4e+10}{M_\odot}$

answer_key.quantity: Host dynamical mass at R=8.0 kpc

evidence.quote: derive the half-light radius to be $\SI{6.9+-0.7}{ kpc}$ for the host

not_stated_but_needed: Cleaning iteration limits and primary beam correction details
Flux calibrator and flux scale uncertainty
Aperture/region used for spectrum extraction and moment-0 integration
3DBarolo parameter file details (initial guesses, mask, thresholds)
How FRB-site column density and upper limits were computed in detail
SFR/stellar mass uncertainty propagation for mu_gas and t_depl
score_reason: Single public dataset and basic recipe with clear numbers, but extraction regions and 3DBarolo settings are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Single archival dataset with stated imaging parameters and numeric results (gas mass, FWHM, flux).
